purpose: Traceable test debt for SOURCE_VERIFIED mechanics whose equipment model is not yet certified. Each item is currently handled by a temporary fail-closed guard; the positive tests below are REQUIRED before the model can be certified. Nothing here is a passing test.

items.requirement: A character proficient with darksticks may hold several in one hand; the group counts as one weapon dealing 2d8 instead of 1d6; more than two add no damage.
positiveTests: proficient wielder with a verified group: one attack source, 2d8
single stick 1d6; third stick adds nothing
non-proficient wielder gets no group
group-aware occupancy verification (no arbitrary appendage sharing); no duplicate attacks or stacked damage/effects
member dropped, thrown, transferred or removed dissolves or reduces the group

items.requirement: Worn; +1 damage on successful unarmed attacks; cannot be disarmed or dropped.
items.failClosedGuard: worn weapons are never READIED (grip indeterminate)
positiveTests: verified worn state modifies the unarmed attack (+1 damage)
disarm and drop protection come from certified worn equipment state, not an ordinary weapon grip

items.source: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide p. 202
items.requirement: Worn; the wearer's unarmed melee attacks become stun damage with +1 stun damage; cannot be disarmed or dropped.
items.failClosedGuard: worn weapons are never READIED (grip indeterminate)
positiveTests: verified worn state converts unarmed melee to stun and adds +1 stun damage
disarm and drop protection from certified worn equipment state

items.requirement: Mountable on a large droid or vehicle, or operated from a tripod (treated one size smaller for wielding; a Medium character operates it with two hands); needs a power generator; normally a second adjacent crewman spends a standard action regulating power, otherwise attacks take -2.
items.failClosedGuard: no wielding class is established, so the beam is never READIED; control maintenance ends fail-closed
positiveTests: tripod operation evaluates the published effective size and two-hand requirement
host-mounted operation relies on a separately established host/mount authority
power generator requirement
crew regulation present/absent (-2)
tractor control maintenance roll at the controller's turn start

items.source: Core Rulebook p. 121; Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide p. 202; Galaxy at War p. 42 (see the EQ-003 addendum)
items.requirement: Attacks made with worn or unconventionally operated weapons (wrist weapons, gloves, gauntlets, Sith Lanvarok, Tactical Tractor Beam, Heavy Blaster Cannon for a Medium wielder) must execute with their own published costs once their equipment model is certified.
positiveTests: Wrist Rocket Launcher payload spend and persistence (5D-D)
Shockboxing Gloves stun-switch swift cost and persistence (5D-I-A)
Heavy Blaster Cannon Medium-wielder brace = two swift actions (5D-G)
wrist/dart/blaster attack execution and worn classification (5D-I-D-B2 G)
Combat Gloves / Stunning Gauntlet unarmed modification and disarm protection

items.source: none located (canonical registry record lightsaber-chassis-retrosaber has baseSize null)
items.requirement: The Retrosaber needs a source-verified canonical size so its grip can be verified; until then it is never READIED.
positiveTests: Retrosaber state machine live attacks: swift dial-up, overcharge through the next turn, burnout lock, normal (5D-I-B section E)

items.requirement: Weapons without a certified canonical identity (homebrew/legacy Items) cannot establish a grip and are refused by the attack gate. A certification route is an open domain-design question; no permissive bypass was added.
positiveTests: a certified homebrew weapon attacks after its identity/grip is verified (route to be designed)
